file_roles.evidence: New Type_handler_inet6::partition_field_append_value prints the value with to_string() in single quotes, replacing the generic _binary hex output that broke inet6 partition values.
Only adds override declarations of partition_field_check and partition_field_append_value.
add_column_list_values and the removed check_part_field hard-coded type switch and charset/hex printing; diff delegates to type_handler()->partition_field_check/append_value.
Adds enum partition_value_print_mode_t, new virtual method declarations and trivial per-class overrides, i.e. interface plumbing for the fix in sql_partition.cc.

rationale: The generic partition code wrote INET6 values to the frm as _binary hex, which then failed type checks on insert. The fix replaces that code and gives the inet6 plugin its own printer.
notes: sql_type_inet.cc could be seen as new support code rather than corrected logic; labelled causal because it now decides inet6 output.
